source: 653 Lumian’s Choice
target: 653 Electio Lumiani

source: Franca emerged from the shadows, exhaling a sigh of relief as she saw the silver-white full-body armor return to silence following Lumian’s departure from the warehouse and the absence of weak targets.
target: Franca ex umbris emersit, suspirum solatii exhalans dum vidit loricam totius corporis argenteo-albam in silentium redire postquam Lumian horreum reliquit et absentia debilium obiectorum constabat.

source: With caution, she approached, making sure not to position herself behind the Pride Armor, finally standing face to face with it.
target: Cum cautela accessit, cavens ne se post Loricam Superbiam collocaret, tandem facie ad faciem stans eam.

source: The Pride Armor remained motionless.
target: Lorica Superbia immota manebat.

source: Franca extended her hands, barely lifting the silver-white full-body armor and tucking it back into her Traveler’s Bag.
target: Franca manus suas extendit, vix levans loricam totius corporis argenteo-albam et eam in saccum viatoris recondidit.

source: Only then did she relax and call out, “It’s all right, it’s all right.”
target: Tum solum quievit et exclamavit: “Omnia bene, omnia bene.”

source: Jenna emerged from a dark corner on the other side, and Anthony suddenly appeared at the warehouse door, seemingly prepared to roll and escape at any moment.
target: Jenna ex obscuro angulo altera parte emersit, et Anthony subito ad ianuam horrei apparuit, quasi paratus ad volvendum et effugiendum in quolibet momento.

source: In a matter of seconds, Lumian somersaulted back from a high window, eliciting a chuckle from Franca.
target: In paucis momentis, Lumian ex fenestra alta se gyravit retro, provocans Francae risum.

source: “Damn it, we managed Hisoka just fine, but our own Sealed Artifact nearly wiped us out. Good thing we had substitutes. Otherwise, we might have been severely injured, if not dead,” she remarked.
target: “Heu, Hisokam optime gessimus, sed nostrum proprium Artefactum Sigillatum paene nos delevit. Bene evenit quod substitutos habuimus. Alioquin graviter iniuriam passuri fuimus, si non mortui,” inquit.

source: Jenna commented calmly, “This could be a funny story for Ghost Face.”
target: Jenna tranquille commentavit: “Haec potuit esse fabula iocosa pro Vultu Phantasma.”

source: Having moved out of the market district, she now had plenty of free time.
target: Mercatus regione relicta, nunc multum temporis liberi habebat.

source: Though she still owed Franca a large sum of money, she had enough assets to cover it.
target: Quamquam Francae adhuc magnam pecuniae quantitatem debebat, satis opum habebat ad id solvendum.

source: Thus, while completing the Tarot Club mission and trying to act, she could afford to watch a play once a week, buy magazines, newspapers, and books she had longed for but couldn’t justify purchasing, and indulge in department stores and certain restaurants she had once yearned for.
target: Itaque, dum missionem Taroti Club perficeret et se agere conaret, poterat ludum scaenicum semel in hebdomada spectare, commentarios, diurnos, et libros emere, quos diu desideraverat sed emere non poterat iustificare, atque in mercatis et quibusdam popinis se delectare.

source: Franca let out a hollow laugh.
target: Franca risum inane edidit.

source: “Who would have thought this armor would hold such a grudge? Hey Lumian, what did you do to it?”
target: “Quis putavit hanc loricam talem rancorem tenere? Heus Lumian, quid in eam fecisti?”

source: she inquired, directing the subsequent questions to Lumian.
target: inquit, quaestiones posteras ad Lumian dirigens.

source: Lumian spread his hands.
target: Lumian manus suas protendit.

source: “Wasn’t it just a backstab?
target: “Nonne solum vulneratio in tergo fuit?

source: “I thought it would be fine after disengaging and waiting for it to calm down.”
target: Putabam id fore in ordine postquam discesserim et eum requiescere exspectaverim.

source: Franca nodded repeatedly, offering him a way out.
target: Franca recurrenter annuit, ei viam exitu praebens.

source: “That’s right, I thought so too.
target: “Ita, et ego ita putabam.

source: “It’s all because of that armor! It doesn’t feel like armor at all!”
target: “Omnia propter illam loricam sunt! Minime videtur quasi lorica!”

source: After a moment of pondering, Franca said, “I wonder when it will forget that you stabbed it in the back. For now, you’ll have to leave it with me.”
target: Post paulum meditando, Franca dixit: “Miror quando obliviscatur quod eam in tergo percussisti. Nunc eam mecum relinquere tibi oportet.”

source: “Alright,” Lumian said, feeling a twinge of regret. Such a useful Sealed Artifact was temporarily unusable.
target: “Recte,” dixit Lumian, paenitentiam sentiens. Talis utilis Artefactum Sigillatum pro tempore inutilis erat.

source: He glanced at Hisoka’s severely damaged corpse and the seemingly unscathed Beyonder characteristic, stowing them away in his Traveler’s Bag.
target: Lumian oculos ad corpus Hisokae graviter laesum et ad proprietatem Beyonder, quae vix laesa videbatur, vertit, ea in sacco viatoris reponens.

source: He said seriously, “I hope that the operation against the Minister of Industry will commence after the Sealed Artifact is completed. Though its negative effects will undoubtedly be severe, Desire Apostle and Wraith are definitely very useful, even if they can only unleash a portion of their abilities.”
target: Serio dixit: “Spero operatio contra Minister Industriae incipere postquam Artefactum Sigillatum conficietur. Etsi effectus eius negativos sine dubio graves erunt, Apostolus Desiderii et Wraith certe valde utiles sunt, etiamsi solum partem virium suarum efferre possint.”

source: “Indeed,” Franca replied, filled with anticipation.
target: Profecto, respondit Franca, spe plena.

source: She then turned to Lumian and asked, “Hisoka is already dead. You’ve achieved your goal in the Southern Continent. Where are you going next? Are you returning to Trier with us?”
target: Deinde ad Lumian conversam, rogavit: “Hisoka iam mortuus est. Finem tuum in Continente Australi attigisti. Quo nunc pergis? Ad Trier nobiscum revertieris?”

source: Lumian shook his head, as if he had already considered the answer to this question.
target: Lumian caput movit, quasi responsum huius quaestionis iam cogitavisset.

source: “I plan to stay in the Southern Continent for a while longer.”
target: “Consilium habeo manere in Continente Australi adhuc aliquantulum.”

source: “Why? To investigate Tizamo Town and the Hisoka matter? That doesn’t seem necessary,” Jenna expressed her confusion.
target: “Cur? Ad explorandum Oppidum Tizamo et rem Hisokae? Id non videtur necessarium,” Jenna dixit.

source: Lumian chuckled.
target: Lumian subridens risit.

source: “This is a Hunter’s paradise, don’t you think?”
target: “Hic est paradisus venatorum, nonne putas?”

source: Without waiting for Franca and the others to inquire further, Lumian explained seriously, “After all that has transpired, I’ve come to realize something. For a Hunter to act well and digest swiftly, they must undergo diverse experiences.”
target: Ne Francae et ceterorum ulteriora quaerenda exspectans, Lumian serio explicavit: “Post omnia quae contigerunt, aliquid intellexi. Ut venator bene ageret et celeriter res intueretur, oportet variis experientiis subire.”

source: What I mean is, a Hunter’s path is more straightforward compared to other paths.
target: Quod dico, via venatoris simplicior est quam aliae viae.

source: It’s unlike Demonesses who must navigate pleasure, pain, while contemplating abstract and philosophical concepts which are often more intricate.
target: Non est simile daemonissis, quae voluptatem et dolorem peragrandi sunt, dum etiam de notionibus abstractis et philosophicis, saepissime intricatis, meditari cogunt.

source: As long as a Hunter is immersed in chaos, conflict, and constant combat, they can excel.
target: Quamdiu venator in chao, contentione et perpetua pugna immersus est, excellere potest.

source: Combat is akin to hunting.
target: Pugna venationi similis est.

source: Chaos and conflict invariably breed numerous conspiracies.
target: Chaos et contentio ineluctabiliter multas coniurationes gignunt.

source: Provocation smoothens these conspiracies, arson secures victory in battle, and the aftermath of such incidents reaps the lives of enemies and the spoils of victory.
target: Provocatio has coniurationes lenit, incendium pugnae victoriam confirmat, et eventus talium rerum vitas hostium et praemia victoriae metit.

source: Observing Franca, Jenna, and Anthony’s puzzled expressions, Lumian smiled and continued, “It’s been just over half a year since I ascended from Sequence 9 to Sequence 5. Why?
target: Observans vultus perplexos Francae, Jennae, et Anthoni, Lumian subridens pergebat: “Iam paulo plus quam dimidium anni sunt ex quo a Sequencia IX ad Sequencia V ascendissem. Cur?”

source: “Because I’ve been either passively or actively embroiled in a series of events.”
target: “Quia sive passim sive active in seriem rerum implicatus fui.”

source: Through perpetual chaos, disputes, and battles, I’ve grasped the principles of performance and found opportunities to act.
target: Per perpetuum chaos, contentiones et pugnas, principia efficacitatis agendi cepi atque occasiones ad agendum inveni.

source: “In essence, a Hunter doesn’t engage in elaborate acting before reaching High-Sequence Beyonder status.
target: In essentia, venator in agendo elaborato non versatur antequam statum Beyonder Altæ Sequenciae perveniat.

source: Though I possess some insight into fate due to my characteristics, it’s also linked to determination and willpower. It’s an integral part of combat.
target: Quamquam aliquam praenotionem fati propter proprietates meas habeo, illud etiam constantiae et voluntatis coniunctum est; pars integralis pugnae est.

source: Hunters are forged in the crucible of blood and fire.
target: Venatores in crucibili sanguinis et ignis formantur.

source: They thrive amidst chaos and conflict.
target: Inter chaos et contentiones florent.

source: If I aim to grow stronger, I must pursue these elements.
target: Si fortior fieri cupio, hos elementa persequi mihi oportet.

source: The Southern Continent offers precisely that.
target: Continens Australis id prorsus praebet.

source: Thus, Lumian could swiftly assimilate the Reaper potion and strive to become a Sequence 5 Fate Appropriator of the Inevitability pathway.
target: Itaque, Lumian celeriter potionem Messoris assimilavit et contendere coepit ut Sequenciae V Fati Appropriator viae Inevitabilitatis fieret.

source: Only by truly mastering some of fate’s abilities could Lumian hope to uncover any connection between Loki and the ancient castle when he next confronted him.
target: Solum vere quasdam fati facultates percipiens, Lumian sperare potuit ut ullam nexum inter Loki et antiquum castrum detegeret, cum eum proximo tempore occurret.

source: According to Franca, Lumian had to locate the respawn point of an enemy capable of resurrection and camp there!
target: Secundum Francam, Lumian oportuit locum renascentiae hostis, qui ad resurrectionem valere posset, invenire et ibi castra componere!

source: Certainly, the path to becoming a Fate Appropriator came with its own set of risks.
target: Certe, via ad Fati Appropriatorem efficiendum periculis suis insita erat.

source: Lumian’s chances of encountering Circle Inhabitant Voisin Sanson would significantly rise, whether due to the convergence of an Outer Deity’s Blessed resulting from the world’s rejection or the convergence of Inevitability powers.
target: Casus Lumiani ad inveniendum Incolam Circuli Voisin Sanson insigniter augebuntur, sive ex coniunctione benedictionis Deī Externi, ex rejectione mundi resultante, sive ex coniunctione potestatum Inevitabilitatis.

source: Despite his yearning for such an encounter, Lumian was aware that he wasn’t prepared to face a demigod, lacking the corresponding strength.
target: Non obstante desiderio huiusmodi congressus, Lumian sciebat se non paratum esse ad semideum oppugnandum, viribus necessariis carens.

source: A high-level Beyonder he could hire wouldn’t be able to constantly keep an eye on him, and the moment of encounter was beyond his control.
target: Unus Beyonder altus quem conducere posset non semper eum observare valebat, et momentum congressus extra eius potestatem erat.

source: Franca couldn’t hide her envy upon hearing Lumian’s plan.
target: Franca invidiam suam celare non potuit, cum consilium Lumiani audivit.

source: If only the Demoness pathway’s acting were that straightforward.
target: Utinam modus agendi in via daemonissae tam simplex esset.

source: The early stages with Assassins and Instigators were relatively direct, but as time went on, it became more complicated.
target: Initia cum sicariis et instigatoribus erant relative directa, sed cum tempore res magis implicatae fiebant.

source: Sigh. When I first met Lumian, I was clearly at a higher Sequence and stronger than him. It’s only been half a year, but the tables have turned… Franca felt a mix of sorrow and impulsive emotions.
target: Suspiro. Cum primum Lumian convenissem, plane in Sequencia superiora eram et fortior eum fuissem. Dimidium anni tantum praeterierunt, sed res mutatae sunt… Franca miscela tristitiae et impulsivae affectuum sensit.

source: After sending Franca, Jenna, and Anthony back to Trier, Lumian entered Suite 7 on B3 of Hotel Orella, signaling for Lugano to leave.
target: Postquam Francam, Jennae, et Anthoni ad Trier remitterit, Lumian in Suite 7, in B3 de Hotel Orella, intravit, signum dedit ut Lugano discederet.

source: Then, he carefully extracted Hisoka’s lifeless body from his Traveler’s Bag and positioned it in front of Ludwig.
target: Deinde, caute corpus Hisokae inanimatum ex sacco viatoris extraxit et coram Ludovico disposuit.

source: With a grin, he remarked, “Here’s my end of the bargain. Is it edible?”
target: Subridens, inquit, “Ecce pars mea pacti. Num edibile est?”

source: Ludwig, clutching a silver child’s knife and fork with a steak laid out before him, sprung up from his seat.
target: Ludwig, tenens cultrum puerile argenteum et furcam, cum frustum carnis ante se posito, ex sede surrexit.

source: As he examined the torn, half‐Devil‐like, and bloodied remains, a mix of desire and hesitation played across his face.
target: Dum reliquias laceratas, semi diaboli similes, et sanguinolentas perlustrebat, mixtura cupiditatis et dubitationis in facie eius effulgebat.

source: It was clear he was tempted but wary.
target: Manifestum erat eum temptatum esse sed cautum.

source: After more than ten seconds, Ludwig delicately picked up the child’s utensils and resolved himself.
target: Post plus quam decem secundas, Ludwig leniter instrumenta pueri sustulit et decrevit.

source: “A tiny bit.”
target: “Paululum.”

source: Without awaiting Lumian’s reply, he crouched down and extended the child’s knife and fork toward Hisoka’s still open, flaxen-colored eyes.
target: Nondum responsum Lumiani exspectans, se inclinavit et cultrum ac furcam pueri ad Hisokae oculos, qui adhuc patebant et flavos colore fulgebant, protendit.

source: Amidst the slicing sounds, Ludwig retrieved the Devil-like eyeballs, one on the fork and the other on the knife’s tip.
target: Inter sonos secandi, Ludwig extrahivit oculos diaboli similes, unum in furca et alterum in cultri acie.

source: Then, he poured a glass of orange Gwadar with one hand.
target: Deinde, una manu poculum Gwadar aurantiaceum effudit.

source: “There’s caffeine in this. Not suitable for children,” Lumian pointed out.
target: “Hic caffeine continetur. Non aptum est pueris,” Lumian innotuit.

source: Ludwig glanced at the enticing beverage, then at the eyeballs on the child’s utensils, and the half‐Devil corpse on the ground. He fell silent.
target: Ludwig ad potum allicientem, deinde ad oculos in instrumentis pueri et corpus semi-diabolicum in terra aspiciens, mutus fuit.

source: Lumian also fell silent.
target: Lumian quoque silentium obtinuit.

source: After a few moments, Ludwig submerged the eyeballs into the orange-yellow Gwadar, deliberately puncturing more holes with his fork to allow the liquid to seep out.
target: Post paucos momentos, Ludwig oculos in Gwadar aurantiaco-flavum immergit, furca sua deliberanter plura foramina sculpens, ut liquorem effluere sineret.

source: Then, he lifted the drink and squatted beside Hisoka’s corpse, bringing the glass to a spot where some blood still dripped.
target: Deinde, poculum levavit et juxta corpus Hisokae, se genu flectens, consedit, ad locum ducens ubi adhuc aliqua sanguinis gutta stillabat.

source: Bloop! Bloop! Bloop! Three drops of sulfur-scented blood fell into the fading orange beverage, swiftly tinting it with the color of blood.
target: Bloop! Bloop! Bloop! Tres guttae sanguinis, sulphure odorantes, in potionem aurantiacum evanidantem ceciderunt, celeriter eam sanguinis colore tinctae.

source: Ludwig swirled the liquid in the glass and consumed it.
target: Ludwig liquorem in poculo circumvolvit et consumpsit.

source: Lumian observed as Ludwig finished his drink, noting a clear boost in energy.
target: Lumian observavit dum Ludwig potionem finivit, animadvertens energiam clarissime augeri.

source: Curious, he inquired, “What’s the effect of this?”
target: Curiosus, interrogavit: “Quid hoc efficit?”

source: Ludwig licked his lips and responded, “Permanently enhances my spirituality, allowing me to keenly sense the aura of the Abyss. I can also command a few lower-level undead creatures.”
target: Ludwig labia sua lambuit et respondit: “Spiritualitatem meam permanentiter auget, mihi permittens aurem Abyssi acutissime sentire; etiam paucos creaturas mortuorum inferiorum imperare possum.”

source: “Only the first glass has this effect. Subsequent drinks of a similar nature can only temporarily heighten my perception and restore some spirituality.”
target: “Sola prima poculi hoc effectum habet. Subsequentia pocula similis naturae solum temporarie perceptionem meam augeant atque aliquam spiritualitatem restituant.”

source: Ludwig’s tone carried a maturity as he spoke on such matters.
target: Tonus Ludovici, cum de his rebus loqueretur, maturitatem ostendebat.

source: Not bad… but only you would dare to consume such a messy thing… Lumian criticized inwardly.
target: Non male… sed solum tu auderes talem sordidam rem consumere… Lumian in corde reprehendit.

source: He stowed away Hisoka’s remains and retreated to his bedroom, initiating a letter to Madam Magician.
target: Reliquias Hisokae reponens et se in cubiculum recepit, epistolam ad Dominam Magician scribere coepit.

source: The focus was on reporting Hisoka’s apparent identity, his speculations, and the issues with Tizamo Town.
target: Intentio erat de identitate apparenti Hisokae, eius conjecturis, atque de quaestionibus cum Oppido Tizamo referre.

source: Additionally, he proposed that the reward for these unexpected discoveries should be the transformation of Hisoka’s Beyonder characteristic into a Sealed Artifact.
target: Praeterea, proposuit ut praemium pro his inopinatis inventis esset transformatio proprietatis Hisokae Beyonder in Artefactum Sigillatum.

source: Having neatly folded the letter, Lumian produced a jagged black crystal clump and arranged a ritual.
target: Epistulam diligenter plicatam, Lumian crystallum atrum angulosum produxit et ritum instituit.

source: He called forth Madam Magician’s doll messenger.
target: Invocavit pupam nuntiam Dominae Magician.

source: Upon its emergence, the doll messenger emitted a disdainful sound, pinching its nose.
target: Cum emerguit, nuntius pupae sonum spretii edidit, nasum suum prehendens.

source: It pointed at Hisoka’s Beyonder characteristic and remarked in a sharp voice,
target: Illud ad proprietatem Hisokae Beyonder intendit et acuto voce dixerit,

source: “Pack it into a box! It’s filthy!”
target: “Pone illud in cista! Sordidum est!”

source: Lumian retrieved a small paper box from his Traveler’s Bag and stuffed the black crystal clump inside.
target: Lumian parvam cistam chartaceam ex sacco viatoris extraxit et in eam nodum crystallum atrum replevit.

source: “Tie it up.”
target: “Ligare illud.”

source: “Stuff it in another box.”
target: “Reple illud in aliam cistam.”

source: “Use another box to contain them.”
target: “Utere alia cista ad eos continendos.”

source: The doll messenger continued with its requests.
target: Nuntius pupae petitiones suas continuavit.

source: Finally, it begrudgingly picked up the box and carried the letter away.
target: Denique, vili animo, cistam sustulit et epistolam auferens abiit.

source: Port Pylos’s patrol team.
target: Turma vigilum Portus Pylos.

source: Reaza informed Camus, “All the problematic team members have been purged. The rest are undergoing individual reviews. You are part of it too.”
target: Reaza informavit Camus: “Omnes sodales problematici expulsi sunt; reliqui singillatim examinantur; tu quoque eorum partis es.”

source: “How’s Kolobo?” Camus asked with concern.
target: “Quid agit Kolobo?” Camus sollicite quaesivit.

source: “He’s fine. We went to the Earth Mother Church to hire a Doctor,” Reaza replied calmly. “The major issue now is that we haven’t apprehended Twanaku. Moreover, we’re certain that he’s both a Wraith and a Desire Apostle.”
target: “Is bene est; ad Ecclesiam Matris Terrae ivimus ut Medicum conduceremus,” Reaza tranquille respondit. “Praecipuum problema nunc est quod Twanaku non apprehendimus. Porro certi sumus eum simul Wraith et Apostolum Desiderii esse.”

source: “How? Isn’t he too powerful?” Camus felt a twinge of fear at the thought of potential retaliation from Twanaku.
target: “Quomodo? Nonne nimis potens est?” Camus metu aliquo sensit, de potestate ultio a Twanaku cogitans.

source: At that moment, a patrol team member entered the office and informed Reaza and Camus, “Captain Reaza, Boss, the straw hat guy is back!”
target: Membrum turmae vigilum officium intravit et Reaza et Camus informavit: “Dux Reaza, Praefecte, vir pileatus stramineus rediit!”
